coordination.label: OCHA
coordination.ocha_plan: Niger Besoins Humanitaires et Plan de Réponse 2026 (HNRP)
coordination.note: HNRP coordinated by OCHA (Humanitarian Forum, working groups run by OCHA). UNHCR's 2026-27 Sahel+ Strategy is a strategy, not an RRP, and its list of countries includes Niger; no Nigeria-situation RRP chapter found. Existing record notes the FTS plan includes a Refugee Response component (not re-verified).

cwg_reliefweb.page_title: Niger (country response hub; no dedicated Cash Working Group page found)
cwg_reliefweb.last_update_basis: Hub lists a 4W for Jan-Dec 2025 but gives no posting date
cwg_reliefweb.dashboard_name: Niger: Les interventions en transfert monétaire - Qui fait quoi, Où, Comment (4W)
cwg_reliefweb.contacts_basis: CALP West and Central Africa CWG leads report (Jul 2026): OCHA is co-lead, second co-lead not named; CALP CWG listing shows WFP and OCHA contacts. Group described as multisectoral cash working group active since 2017.
cwg_reliefweb.note: The Niger hub has no CWG page or contacts block; the 4W item is listed without a link.

cva_delivered_usd.note: A hub-page reading gave 17.3bn FCFA (about US$31M, 1.3M people, Jan-Dec 2025) but the figure is not in the page text and sits behind the 'Intervention en transfert monétaire' dashboard; not verifiable, so recorded as not found. Re-check in a browser.

mpc_delivered_usd.note: MPC split not given in the hub text.

sectoral_cva_delivered_usd.note: Sectoral split not given in the hub text.

fsps.name: BNIF-AFUWA (Bureau nigérien d'intermédiation financière)
fsps.evidence: Paid cash-in-envelope transfers at its offices in a 2020 WFP/UNAIDS pilot (65,000 FCFA per household across seven regions). Old evidence; current use not confirmed.

fsps_note: No 2025-2026 source naming FSPs used for humanitarian cash in Niger was found. UNHCR Niger Q3 2025 update (33,882 people received cash) and a GOAL Niger e-money ToR (Jul 2025) refer only to unnamed financial service providers. A CWG regional minute (May 2024) notes difficulties with bank transfers and liquidity.
